message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data built into this chat, so I’m not able to pull up today’s exact temperature or forecast for London right now.  

If you’re looking for the latest weather:

| Source | How to check |
|--------|--------------|
| **Weather.com** (The Weather Channel) | Go to www.weather.com/uk/london |
| **BBC Weather** | Visit https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/location/2643748 |
| **AccuWeather** | Search “London” on accuweather.com |
| **Google** | Type “London weather” – Google will show a quick snapshot |

These sites update hourly and include details like temperature, humidity, wind speed, chance of rain, and a short-term outlook. If you’d like me to explain how to interpret those numbers or help set up alerts, let me know!

We could ask clarifying question about time/date. Or just state can't access real-time but suggest checking reliable sources. Let's do friendly.
